subject: Marine Works - Halifax Harbour and Approaches - Dartmouth
text:
Marine Works - Halifax Harbour and Approaches - Dartmouth
Installation of 80 m long rock revetment in front of Tufts Cove Generating Station Plant. Revetment will be installed from barges. Work will be on a 24/7 basis, directly in front of the Tufts Cove plant and behind the unloading pier within a 1500 m² area spanning 40 m to the north and south and 20 m to the west of 44 40.524N 063 35.791W. Wide berth requested in the vicinity of barge operations.
